regime_read: The strongest convergence sits in enterprise AI infrastructure and semiconductors, led by IBM and MU, while MSFT and PLTR require entry discipline because relative strength is near or beyond the extension threshold. The track record is directionally positive but has only two scored observations, so conviction remains provisional and low.
regime_read_zh: 当前最强的信号汇聚集中在企业级 AI 基础设施与半导体，IBM 和 MU 居前；MSFT 的相对强势已接近追高阈值，PLTR 则明显超涨，因此需要严格控制入场纪律。历史记录方向表现良好，但仅有 2 个已评分样本，所有置信度仍应视为暂定且偏低。

theses.thesis: IBM has the cleanest cross-channel alignment: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity, insider-buying pressure, a large patent cluster, and simultaneous GitHub and model-download momentum point toward improving enterprise-AI and government demand [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum]. Relative strength is positive but not extended, although earnings in five days create near-term event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM 的跨渠道一致性最清晰：联邦合同活动大幅加速、内部人士买入压力、较大的专利集群，以及 GitHub 与模型下载动能同步出现，共同指向企业级 AI 和政府需求改善 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum]。其相对强势为正但尚未超涨，不过五个交易日后公布财报带来短期事件风险。
second_order: Enterprise AI software and consulting — IBM's developer and model momentum implies broader implementation demand [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum].
Government IT modernization vendors — IBM's contract acceleration suggests an improving federal technology-spending channel [gov_contract_accel].
Hybrid-cloud infrastructure — patent and developer activity imply continuing enterprise deployment needs [patent_cluster] [github_momentum].
theses.dissent: The signals may reflect activity rather than monetization, and the earnings announcement in five days could overwhelm the medium-horizon read.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and developer or model-download momentum weakens without corresponding commercial growth.

theses.thesis: MU combines six signals across policy support, insider behavior, intellectual property, analyst positioning, and retail sentiment [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its negative 60-day relative performance means the convergence is not already reflected in an extended move. The disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation adds a policy-network signal but is qualitative and should carry limited weight [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU 汇集了六类信号，覆盖政策支持、内部人士行为、知识产权、分析师立场与散户情绪 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。过去 60 天相对表现为负，意味着这些汇聚信号尚未体现在超涨行情中。披露的 Ro Khanna 关联增加了政策网络信号，但该信息属于定性证据，权重应保持有限 [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: Memory-production equipment — improving MU expectations would imply firmer fabrication and packaging demand [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster].
AI-server memory supply chain — policy support and positive positioning point to potential demand for memory-intensive compute [gov_grant] [analyst_upgrade_cluster].
Domestic semiconductor manufacturing — the grant signal supports the broader onshore-capacity theme [gov_grant].
theses.dissent: Analyst upgrades and uniformly bullish retail sentiment may be crowded expressions of the same expected memory-cycle recovery rather than independent information.

falsifier.text: Government support fails to translate into improving operating demand while analyst and insider signals reverse.

theses.thesis: AZN shows coherent pipeline-to-commercial convergence through numerous Phase 3 starts, an FDA approval, and a label expansion [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion]. The channels are related rather than fully independent, so this is a lower-confidence healthcare pipeline read despite the absence of price extension.
theses.thesis_zh: AZN 呈现出从研发管线到商业化的连贯汇聚：多项三期临床启动，同时出现 FDA 批准与适应症标签扩展 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion]。这些渠道彼此相关，并非完全独立，因此即使股价没有超涨，这仍只是低置信度的医药管线判断。
second_order: Clinical-research services — a broad Phase 3 program supports trial-management demand [clinical_phase3_start].
Biopharma manufacturing services — approvals and label expansion can increase commercialization and production requirements [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion].
Specialty-care distribution — expanded approved use can broaden treatment-channel activity [fda_label_expansion].
theses.dissent: The apparent convergence is concentrated within one regulatory and clinical complex, while one clinical halt shows that pipeline risk remains active.

falsifier.text: Material trial setbacks or weak uptake prevent the approvals and label expansion from producing broader commercial demand.

theses.thesis: MSFT has alignment across app demand, patents, political buying, and its factual partnership with Sam Altman [app_demand] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]. However, its 60-day relative strength is 34.9 percentage points, effectively at the desk's extension boundary, so the evidence supports watching for a better entry rather than chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT 的应用需求、专利活动、政治人物买入信号以及与 Sam Altman 的事实性合作关系形成一致指向 [app_demand] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]。但其过去 60 天相对强势达到 34.9 个百分点，实际上已贴近本桌的超涨界线，因此应等待更合适的入场机会，而不是追高。
second_order: Cloud AI infrastructure — app demand and the Sam Altman partnership imply continuing compute consumption [app_demand] [actor:Sam Altman].
Enterprise AI software — strong application engagement supports adoption across productivity workflows [app_demand].
Data-center power and cooling — sustained cloud-AI usage implies upstream infrastructure demand [app_demand] [patent_cluster].
theses.dissent: The near-extended relative move may already discount strong demand, while affiliation and political signals provide limited information about future fundamentals.

falsifier.text: Application demand weakens or AI-partnership activity fails to support continued cloud and enterprise adoption.

theses.thesis: PLTR's federal-contract acceleration aligns with disclosed political ownership and retail attention [gov_contract_accel] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [retail_buzz]. The fundamental channel is notable, but the evidence set contains only three channels and the stock is explicitly extended after substantially outperforming SPY, so the entry is gone for now.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR 的联邦合同加速与披露的政治人物持仓及散户关注形成一致信号 [gov_contract_accel] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [retail_buzz]。其中基本面渠道值得关注，但证据仅覆盖三个渠道，而且该股相对 SPY 已大幅上涨并被明确标记为超涨，因此当前入场窗口已经错过。
second_order: Government data-integration vendors — PLTR's contract acceleration points to continued public-sector software spending [gov_contract_accel].
Defense and intelligence analytics — rising federal contract activity supports the broader mission-software theme [gov_contract_accel].
Secure cloud infrastructure — government analytics deployments imply supporting compute and security demand [gov_contract_accel].
theses.dissent: Retail attention and investor affiliations may be momentum-following signals, while the extended price leaves substantial downside if contract growth disappoints.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration fades before operating growth catches up with the extended relative valuation.
